Applicants must meet the following requirements: (i) The applicant or their parent/legal guardian must be a member of Flathead Electric Cooperative and served by the Co-op at their primary residence. (ii) Scholarship money must be used to attend an accredited post-secondary education institution in Montana (iii) To remain eligible for scholarships that renew for more than one year, students must remain enrolled consecutively each semester at an accredited post-secondary education institution in Montana.
